findings.issue: 一日 misread: kana renders 一日も as ついたちも ('the 1st of the month'); as a duration ('not even one day') it must be いちにち. The token's own gloss even states 一日 = いちにち.
findings.current: しおわついたちもかかすことができない。
findings.suggested: しおわいちにちもかかすことができない。

findings.issue: Token 一日 carries reading ついたち (calendar '1st of the month'), but in 一日も…ない (duration) the reading is いちにち — the token's en/pt glosses themselves say 一日 = いちにち, contradicting the r field.
２０分 transcribed digit-by-digit as にれいふん ('two-zero minutes'), which is never a valid reading; 20分 is read にじゅっぷん (or にじっぷん).
findings.current: えきまでたくしーでにれいふんかかるでしょう。
findings.suggested: えきまでたくしーでにじゅっぷんかかるでしょう。

findings.issue: Token ２０ has reading にれい (digit-by-digit 'two zero'); in ２０分 it is read にじゅっ (part of にじゅっぷん).
分 after ２０ undergoes sound change and is pronounced ぷん (にじゅっぷん), not ふん, in this context.
Same wrong reading as kana: 'tsuitachi' for 一日 in the duration sense; should be 'ichinichi'.
Same wrong reading as kana: 'nireifun' for ２０分; should be 'nijuppun'.

Leftover QA meta-comment embedded in the learner-facing note of token さ, in BOTH languages: "(gloss en 'to print' está errado)" / "(the en gloss 'to print' is wrong)". It refers to a gloss that no longer exists ('to do' is correct) and must be deleted from both note versions.
findings.current: forma 未然形 (さ) de する, exigida pelo causativo せる (gloss en 'to print' está errado)
findings.suggested: pt-BR: forma 未然形 (さ) de する, exigida pelo causativo せる | en: 未然形 (irrealis) form (さ) of する, required by the causative せる

findings.issue: Token list is corrupted: it begins with stray tokens 見 and 渡せる (null glosses) BEFORE 屋上, duplicating the real 見渡せる token that appears later in its correct position. Reconstructing the sentence from tokens yields 見渡せる twice. Delete tokens[0] and tokens[1].
findings.current: token order: 見, 渡せる, 屋上, から, は, 、… (見渡せる appears again later)
findings.suggested: Delete the two stray leading tokens; list starts with 屋上 and keeps the single 見渡せる token.

findings.issue: English word left untranslated inside the pt-BR explanation: 'é coverage de vocabulário' — learner-facing content must be Portuguese ('cobertura'). The en version confirms the intended word is 'coverage'.
findings.current: O foco aqui é coverage de vocabulário básico (鉛筆) e do verbo なくす no passado.
findings.suggested: O foco aqui é a cobertura do vocabulário básico (鉛筆) e do verbo なくす no passado.

findings.issue: 'The yen rose to the dollar' is unidiomatic English without a rate figure (reads as rising 'up to' the dollar); the standard rendering of ドルに対して高くなった is 'rose against the dollar'.
findings.current: The yen rose to the dollar.
findings.suggested: The yen rose against the dollar.

findings.issue: Comma splice: after 'pergunta negativa educada' a new independent clause begins ('em japonês, perguntar...'), running two sentences together; the en version correctly uses a semicolon there.
findings.current: formando uma pergunta negativa educada, em japonês, perguntar pelo negativo
findings.suggested: formando uma pergunta negativa educada; em japonês, perguntar pelo negativo
